**Explanation (coaching note):**

When your opponent plays Bb4, attacking your c3 knight, look for how that piece is now vulnerable. Your d4 knight can fork the queen and bishop at c6—a classic two-for-one. After Nxc6, Black's best try is Bxc3+ to create chaos, but even after you recapture bxc3, you've won the exchange (rook for knight). Watch for knight forks when pieces gang up on the same weak square.
